generations.prompt:
Create a horizontal 16:9 game environment design mockup for the second location, Crystal Caves, in an existing cozy 2D farming RPG. Use the SECOND supplied image only as art-direction reference: polished hand-painted sprite art with restrained pixel-like crisp outlines, readable silhouettes, soft object shadows, the same orthographic top-down three-quarter camera as that village. The FIRST supplied image shows the existing cave and character scale; redesign its empty repetitive floor completely.

Deliver a clean in-game-like landscape concept, no UI, no lettering, no labels, no title, no frame. Camera directly above in orthographic RPG view with visible front faces of objects, NEVER cinematic perspective. A broad irregular cave chamber enclosed by continuous chunky slate-gray rock cliff walls along the top, left, right and lower edges. Walls have visible top rock surfaces, layered vertical faces, thick contact shadows at their bases; exterior rock mass dark and unobtrusive. A narrow accessible entrance in the lower-left wall and a passage deeper into the cave at upper right. The wall ring should feel naturally assembled from reusable short straight pieces, corners, concave segments and a few 3–5 distinct rock shapes, not a giant bespoke illustration. Interior has a calm muted bluish gray dusty stone floor, varied but low-contrast patches and occasional thin cracks, no checkerboard, no bricks. Keep at least half of the chamber open and readable for movement and combat. Small loose stones only near the walls.

Resource nodes: mining veins firmly embedded in rock ledges at reachable wall bases. Show two blue crystal deposits, two emerald green crystal deposits, one restrained ruby-red deposit, a gray mineral/iron vein with pale metallic flecks, and a plain mineable stone outcrop. Each cluster has a clear different silhouette as well as color, modest size, looks like an individual reusable sprite, spaced widely, no huge center crystal. Very subtle localized colored crystal glow plus warm amber illumination from only two small wall torches by the entrance. Ambient chamber remains readable, cooler toward deeper passage. A tiny existing-style brown-haired adventurer in a blue scarf near the lower center for scale (roughly 5 percent of image height), no enemy crowds. Soft grounding shadows around every wall and rock, no blurry haze. Subtle sparse small cave mushrooms as reusable decor at the edges. Layout designed for actual modular terrain tiles and separate resource sprites; surface graphics straightforward to rebuild. Visually coherent, beautiful but practical, crisp game assets, generous clear floor and grounded readable veins.

Create a reusable modular 2D game asset concept sheet derived from the supplied Crystal Caves scene. SAME polished hand-painted sprite style, SAME orthographic top-down three-quarter RPG camera, slate charcoal rock with crisp detailed surfaces and readable silhouettes. This is a SPRITE SHEET on a genuinely transparent alpha background, NOT a whole environment. No floor, no scenic backdrop, no text, no borders, no guides, no labels, no checkerboard graphic.

Wide horizontal landscape canvas. Precisely twenty clearly separate objects, neatly arranged in FIVE COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, one object per cell, generous transparent gutters, every sprite fully visible and no overlap. Use consistent wall height and stone size. Lighting from upper left, modest shading, avoid large baked colored glow or cast shadow outside silhouettes. Each object must look modular and easy to cut into individual sprites. The wall parts need similar end profiles so they can be assembled.

Row one: five gray cave wall modules: (1) short horizontal straight wall section A with visible cliff front and top, (2) horizontal straight section B with different stone silhouette, (3) vertical wall segment facing right toward walkable floor, (4) vertical wall segment facing left toward walkable floor, (5) low horizontal foreground rock rim with top surface visible.
Row two: five structural pieces: (1) convex left rock corner, (2) convex right rock corner, (3) concave inner rock corner, (4) isolated end-cap rock pillar, (5) small mine doorway with simple timber posts integrated into matching rock; dark aperture, NO ground tile.
Row three: five distinct mineable deposits independent of wall background: (1) bright blue crystal cluster growing out of compact gray stone base, (2) emerald green crystal cluster in stone with different shape, (3) ruby red crystal vein in stone with smaller sharp shards, (4) pale silver/iron metallic mineral vein embedded in dark gray stone, (5) plain gray mineable boulder. Each resource compact, upright at accessible wall base, same scale family as reference.
Row four: five small decorative sprites: (1) thin stalagmite cluster, (2) scattered rubble cluster with 4–6 stones, (3) small bluish cave mushroom cluster, (4) simple amber wall torch, (5) separate small green crystal fragment pile.
Maintain strictly 5x4 grid with empty alpha margins between objects. Keep these assets straightforward for a real tile and sprite based game, consistent camera and palette, no perspective diorama, no character, no UI. This is a concept kit for approval, not a baked map.
